text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~, this cosmetics line is so 
cute~...! But since it's used by 
celebrities, the price is just~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if Onee-chan would like the 
packaging? She loves butterfly motifs, 
after all. Plus, the cosmetics are all 
cool-toned colors!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's go with matching for Cheval-chi! 
Matches plain clothes too! It's a great 
value since everyone can use it! Let's 
give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to negotiate splitting the 
bill~! We got this, we got this~!
